params.body:
**On hold: not to be merged until the look has been approved by the operator. This pull request replaces #916, which can be closed; it also contains and supersedes #914 (calm cool neutrals).**

## Why a new pull request

#916 conflicted with main after #915 (activity: one plain list of measures, a garage table that scrolls in its card) and #917 (the row thumbnail keeps a photo's height below 1550px) were merged. A branch takes one push, so this is the same change rebased on the current main, on a new branch.

How the two conflicts were resolved, main's behaviour first:

- `resources/css/insights.css`: the look still styled the grouped measure list and the two-row garage head that #915 removed. Those rules are gone; #915's block (`.act-maten`, `.act-schuif`, `.act-garages`, the sticky garage name, the 420px column) is kept as merged. On top of it only the tokens: the hover of the sticky name cell reads `--ui-surface-quiet` and the sentence under a block `--ui-ink-3`, like the rest of the file. The quiet list head (13px, weight 400, no capitals) applies to both activity tables through `.act-tabel thead th`.
- `resources/css/refresh.css`: the look set the thumbnail to 66x44 with the old selector `td.cel-foto img`. #917's two rules are kept as merged (`img:not(.ui-photo-img) { width: 60px; height: auto; }` and `.overview_image { width: 66px; height: 44px; }`), so a photo fills its frame.

Nothing of #915 or #917 differs from main: `git diff origin/main` is empty for `app/Livewire/Admin/Activity.php`, `app/Support/Measures.php`, the activity blade, `activity.php` in four languages, `33-p3-integraties.md` and `WhatAGarageDoesIsNotWhatOthersDoWithItsCarsTest.php`.

Checked in a browser on a local demo database (screenshots `look-v2-<screen>-<width>.png` in the session's scratchpad): the activity screen at 1440 and 390 shows one plain list of ten measures (one `tbody`, no group rows), a one-row garage head, and the garage table scrolling inside its card (table 1456px in a 1388px and a 358px frame, page not wider than the screen), heads at 13px and weight 400; own stock at 1440 and 1280 shows a 66x44 frame with the photo (`ui-photo-img`, cover) filling it.

## What is in it, in plain words

The typeface (Inter, three weights) is already live. This adds the rest of the look in one piece:

- **Calmer greys and less blue** (the content of #914): the greys keep a cool undertone but little colour; brand blue only on the main action, a link, focus, and what is selected.
- **Softer ink**: the darkest text is `#22262d` instead of `#15181d`.
- **Quiet table heads and labels**: sentence case, 13px, no spaced capitals, no bold, no tinted band; one thin line under the head.
- **Smaller corners, badges without a dot**: three corners (4px button, field and badge; 6px surface inside a card; 8px card, dialog and menu). A status is a word on a soft surface.
- **Less bold**: 600 only on a page title and the one figure of a block.
- **A lower top bar**: 62px instead of 76px on a desktop.
- **Spacing fixes**: the list head close to the card's edge, rows of the own stock list with their air back, no zebra in own stock, worklist cards as wide as the phone, one left edge on the insights pages, room at the bottom of a menu.
- **A quiet publish button in a row of the own stock list**; the filled blue stays for the one main action of a screen (the vehicle form keeps it filled).

The primary button stays the current brand blue.

## Before and after, measured

The main column was measured for #916, before #915 and #917; only the own stock rows are affected by those.

| | main | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| top bar, desktop (from 1200px) | 76px | 62px |
| page padding under the bar | 82px | 68px (title still 20px under the bar) |
| sticky head of own stock | 76px | 62px, under the bar |
| own stock row at 1440 | 60px high, thumbnail 60x28 (measured before #917, which made it 66x44 on main too) | 65px, thumbnail 66x44 |
| own stock, 20 rows at 1440 | 1640px page | 1769px page |
| own stock card on a phone | 360x293 | 360x293 (unchanged) |
| corners (control / surface / card) | seventeen values from 4 to 22px, pills | 4 / 6 / 8px |
| rules at weight 600 in our stylesheets | 161 | 13 |
| full ink | `#15181d` | `#22262d` (15.1 to 1 on white) |
| insights, left edge of title and blocks | 50px and 75px | 25px on every tab |

Screenshots (local, scratchpad of the session): `ls3-before-<screen>-<width>.png` and `ls3-after-<screen>-<width>.png` for own stock, stocklist, stocklist detail, vehicle form, bidding offers and detail, transport, worklists, insights (each tab), my insights, a settings form, users, relations, orders, offers, login and the 404 page, at 1440 and 390; own stock also at 768, 1024 and 1200; the top bar menus as `ls3-after-menu-<name>.png`.

## What the review of the quick commits found and fixed

- **Top bar offsets.** The head of the own stock list and the filter chips stuck at 60px, two pixels under the 62px bar; the filter of the Stocklist still stuck at 80px and the action column of a car at 92px, both sized for the old bar. The height is now one token, `--ui-bar-h` (65px phone, 0 between 768 and 1199px where the bar scrolls away with the page, 62px from 1200px), and what sticks reads `--ui-sticky-top`, which adds the delegation bar. `buybox-scroll.js` measures the bar instead of repeating 92. Two older faults went with it: a sticky head 76px below the top of a tablet screen with nothing above it, and a sticky head under the bar while looking along with a garage (measured with the bar simulated: head at 60px, bar ending at 102px; now 102px). Checked at 390, 768, 1024, 1200 and 1440.
- **Publish button.** On one line it pushed the last column out of the card at 1024px (table 980px in a 974px card, page 2px wider than the screen). It is on one line from 1200px, and wraps below as before. The form's publish button stays filled; the amber draft button keeps its amber icon.
- **Insights.** The container rule matched the page's own container on two of the four tabs, so the title stood at 25px there and at 50px on Werking and Gebruik. Every tab starts at 25px now. The stylesheet only travels to the insights pages; my insights is unchanged (no nested container). The head of the activity table follows the head of every list.
- **Softer ink.** `TheNeutralsLiveInOnePlaceTest` pinned the old value; two shadows on the error and stopped pages still carried it. All text pairs stay above 4.5 to 1 (the test computes them).
- **Corners.** With a control at 4px, the marks had to stay smaller: checkbox boxes 5 to 3px; grooves, scrollbar thumbs and the old switch are round. The card of the error and stopped pages reads the tokens. The corners are 4/6/8, not the 6/8/10 noted earlier.
- **Menu padding.** Checked on Beheer, Biedingen and Administratie with hover and active rows.

## Tests

- New `TheShapeIsQuietTest` (R P1-1.27): the list head carries no capitals, spacing or weight; every corner in our stylesheets is one of the three tokens, round, or a mark of 3px or less; a badge has no dot; a budget of 13 rules at weight 600; the top bar height is one token and nothing sticky carries its own number.
- `TheNeutralsLiveInOnePlaceTest` and `BuyboxSidebarScrollTest` updated to the new values.
- Full suite on the rebased branch: 2746 tests green (1 skipped, 1 incomplete, as on main). eslint without errors, vitest 16 of 16, pint on the new file. No application PHP changed, so no PHPStan run.
- `refresh.css` 5994 lines and 470 `!important`, against 6071 lines on main; the ratchet is at the measured values.

## Judgement calls

- Between 768 and 1199px the bar is not fixed, so sticky things now stop at the top of the screen instead of 60 to 92px below it.
- The quiet publish button also applies on the phone cards; "Aanpassen" is the filled action there.
- A weight budget instead of a list of allowed selectors: cheap, and it only goes down.

## Not verified

- The mega menu of an operator and the operator lists under Beheer (the local accounts are garage administrators).
- The delegation bar with a real delegated session; the offsets were measured with the bar simulated.
- The settings tabs render empty locally on main too, so they were checked through a settings form (location) only.

## Follow-ups, not in this pull request

- The floating blue notification button at the right page edge overlaps content.
- The dialog and `x-ui.figure`; answer first per list.
- Public pages (proposal, dealer website, embed), mails and PDFs.
- The chatbot screen keeps its own corner values (bubbles); the transport status in the worklist widget is still a black badge.
- At 1200px the top bar clips the language and user menu when all menu items are present (also on main).
params.title: [On hold] The look in one piece: calm neutrals, quiet heads, small corners, less bold, a lower top bar
